desc: 陶灰浆墙木台硬侧光系，讲透垫体贴合轮廓、包边与单片独立包装
name: 孕产溢乳垫陶墙侧光款

shots.intent: 首屏一眼把本品讲清楚是妈妈自己用的圆垫形溢乳垫而不是任何穿用式尿裤，硬侧光和陶墙木台先把气质立住。

shots.intent: 把哺乳期最劝退的四个日常瞬间摆到第二屏，让买家先点头再听卖点，全程不出现婴儿正脸与渗漏画面。

shots.intent: 同机位同光双格，只比看得见的构造：垫体厚薄轮廓、贴合穹面与两片侧翼贴胶，一眼看出差别在哪。
shots.textZone: headline 「{selling_point_3}」 at 30pt in #2B2622 in the top band; one solid #A8402A square under each panel, left 「{callout_6}」 and right 「{callout_7}」 at 13pt; two hairline leader labels 「{callout_8}」 at 12pt pointing at the bonded edge and the tab wing; no badges, no arrows implying data, no numerals

shots.intent: 把触面压点、穹面走势和周圈热熔包边做成看得见的做工证据，替掉一切口播式承诺。

shots.intent: 低后侧角同时拍到单片密封小袋的压边、撕口和半抽出的垫体，把随带与分装这件事讲成画面证据。

shots.intent: 俯拍把乳垫放回妈妈自己的随身动线里，用布袋与钥匙锚定真实尺度并交代取用方式。

shots.intent: 俯视把展开、对折合贴、装回单片袋三种形态同框摆清，把取用与携带疑问一次解决并收束选款。

style.backgroundSystem: one interior shelf corner: a hand-troweled lime-plaster wall #CBB49C with visible trowel arcs falling into #B79A80 in its own shadow, crossed by three or four hard-edged parallel shadow bands as if sun passed a slatted screen from camera-right; a solid timber ledge #7A4E33 with its lit edge #8F5F3F runs across the lower third and is the only stage; copy fields sit on #F1EADF paper panels with a 1pt #2B2622 hairline keyline and one clay-red #A8402A corner tab; section breaks are a single clay-red #A8402A square plus a hairline rule; depth stays shallow, architectural and interior; never a seamless studio sweep, never floating rings, never an arch panel, never stacked plinth blocks, never a wave band, never a quilted nursery play mat, never a grass or outdoor mat field, never a clinical white room
style.direction: sun-lit clay-plaster maternity shelf commerce, warm architectural still-life ecommerce for disposable breast pads used by the mother herself
style.iconSystem: a solid charcoal square #2B2622 at 10pt carrying one small off-white #F1EADF centre dot, used identically as bullet, step marker, row anchor and callout head, always one square per short label on one baseline; a larger solid clay-red #A8402A square is the only emphasis marker and never carries a pictogram; thin #2B2622 hairline leader lines only; flat single-weight, no fill gradient; no cotton-boll pictogram, no cloud pictogram, no droplet, no feather, no shield, no leaf pip, no circle-with-pip marker, no pill capsule outline, no rounded-square colour tiles, no 3D icons, no cartoon illustration
style.lightingSystem: one hard warm directional key at about 4500K entering from camera-right at roughly twenty-five degrees off the wall, throwing crisp-edged banded shadow stripes across the plaster and the timber ledge, one true contact shadow directly under every resting object plus one stretched shadow to camera-left; the lit edge of the timber ledge #8F5F3F always faces the key; surfaces stay matte with a single low specular streak only where the backing film turns over; no near-shadowless flat wrap, no frontal fill, no rim flash, no dark falloff to black, no cool daylight; the same 4500K camera-right banded logic holds inside every scene and grid frame so the set never splits into two lighting worlds
style.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent sun-lit clay-plaster maternity shelf ecommerce visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of lime-plaster wall #CBB49C with its shadow #B79A80, timber ledge #7A4E33 with lit edge #8F5F3F, off-white copy paper #F1EADF, ink #2B2622 for headline type and hairlines, sub-text in #7C2A19, and one single accent square in cooked clay red #A8402A, with any product-derived accent supplied as {accent_color}; warm temperature throughout; one hard key at about 4500K entering from camera-right at roughly twenty-five degrees, throwing crisp parallel banded shadow stripes across the plaster and the ledge, one true contact shadow under every resting object plus one stretched shadow to camera-left, never a near-shadowless flat wrap, never a high-key sweep, never cool frontal fill; style.presentationRules: the breast pad is the only hero and keeps its identity on every screen: thin oval disc body with its own proportions, gently domed centre, fine embossed dimple pitch, fused bonded perimeter edge, two short lateral adhesive tab wings and the reference colourway, never re-tinted, never restyled and never redrawn as a diaper, a panty liner or a rectangular under-pad; the pack shell keeps its original stand-up silhouette, top seal strip and side gusset and panel placement with its print panel left blank and no added wordmark; shown spread, half-folded with tabs closed, stacked in its sachet or in macro, always grounded by a true contact shadow on the timber ledge, never floating, never cropped at the resting edge; verticals and the ledge line stay truly straight; the matte touch face and the film backing and film sachet are always rendered as three different materials; one real scale anchor (the timber ledge edge, a folded cloth, a plain pouch, keys) appears in every frame; any adult is clothed, seen from behind or cropped at the neck, hands rendered with real skin texture; no infant is ever changed or held unattended and no nursing act, breast, cleavage or lingerie is ever shown
style.surfaceSystem: the timber ledge #7A4E33 with grain ridges and its lit edge #8F5F3F is the only surface; #F1EADF matte paper for copy fields; one coarse plain-weave folded cloth is the only soft textile; the product keeps its own finishes: the touch face reads as a matte fibrous nonwoven with a visible embossed dimple pitch and the backing and the individual sachet read as a smooth low-sheen film with one controlled specular streak, the two never rendered alike and never as paper, never as plastic gloss; the pad's bonded perimeter seam reads as a fused narrow line
style.typography: one sturdy condensed Chinese sans display family for headlines set tight with a letter-spaced Latin kicker above, plus one light geometric sans for body and labels; headline type in #2B2622 at 26-40pt on #F1EADF, subline in #7C2A19 at 13-16pt, label type in #2B2622 at 10-14pt beside a solid clay-red #A8402A square; one left-aligned column with a vertical clay-red #A8402A rule as the layout spine on every screen; identical hierarchy and hairline weights throughout; all Chinese copy supplied as placeholders wrapped in 「」; no rounded bubble lettering, no capsule pill labels, no serif, no handwriting
